No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; tests fixture-only with invented people. Never read secret files; secrets flow only through the scripts/secret_exec.py subprocess pattern at RUNTIME, never in tests.

OWNED FILES (first two new; the controller pair exists at HEAD — read fully first):
  scripts/hubspot_stage_sync.py
  tests/test_hubspot_stage_sync.py
  scripts/funnel_controller.py

CONTEXT (owner order, Ankit 2026-08-03: 'fix them and create system to do that'): today the coordinator hand-fixed 3 stale HubSpot podcast_status records (a published guest still marked recording-booked). The system must now detect, propose, and — ONLY after explicit human approval — apply such corrections, with receipts at every step. Governance: CRM writes are approval-gated per batch; the automation may NEVER apply without a human approval artifact. Read scripts/hubspot_roster.py (fetch pattern, secret_exec re-invocation, roster schema with stage_hubspot) and the latest focus receipt shape in scripts/funnel_evidence.py (hubspot_stage_mismatches entries {person, ledger_stage, hubspot_stage}).

BUILD scripts/hubspot_stage_sync.py — module + CLI:
1. propose --state-dir D --roster <hubspot-roster json> [--out <path default D/receipts/stage-sync-proposal-<UTC ts>.json>]: reads the newest funnel-focus receipt in D/receipts (hubspot_stage_mismatches) plus D/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json, and classifies every mismatch into: (a) crm_stale — repo/ledger evidence is AHEAD of HubSpot (e.g. ledger stage published/recorded while HubSpot says an earlier stage): propose a HubSpot correction {hs_id, person, from_stage, to_stage, evidence: named ledger/receipt refs}; (b) ledger_behind — HubSpot is ahead (ledger new_inbound/etc. while HubSpot shows later): NO CRM change; emit a ledger_backfill entry instead {person, ledger_stage, hubspot_stage} for the ledger to absorb as evidence; (c) ambiguous — conflicting or missing evidence: emit under needs_human with the reason. Output proposal JSON {schema: 'stage-sync-proposal/v1', generated_at, crm_corrections: [...], ledger_backfill: [...], needs_human: [...], approval: null}. Propose NEVER writes to HubSpot. Stage-order comparison uses the podcast_status enum order: nominated < outreach-sent < responded < followup-sent < prep-booked < prep-done < recording-booked < recorded < in-production < publish-queued < published < promo-sent < complete; declined and stalled are terminal side-states, never auto-proposed as corrections in either direction (always needs_human).
2. apply --proposal <path> --approved-by <name> --approval-ref <card/message ref>: refuses (exit 3, message 'approval artifact required') unless BOTH flags are present and the proposal file's approval field is null (no double-apply). Applies ONLY the crm_corrections list via HubSpot v3 PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/<hs_id> using the SAME self-re-invocation-under-secret_exec pattern as hubspot_roster.py (--api-cmd override for tests; inner _do_patch subcommand reading HUBSPOT_API_KEY from env; never log the key). After each PATCH, VERIFY by re-fetching that contact's podcast_status and comparing; any mismatch marks that correction failed. Then writes back the proposal file with approval: {approved_by, approval_ref, applied_at, results: [{hs_id, ok, verified_stage}]} and a receipt D/receipts/stage-sync-apply-<ts>.json. Partial failure exits nonzero.
3. ledger-backfill --proposal <path> --state-dir D: for each ledger_backfill entry, update that person's stage in D/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json to the mapped ledger vocabulary (reuse the hubspot->ledger stage mapping documented in scripts/funnel_evidence.py — import it if exposed, else replicate and note the source), append 'hubspot:stage-backfill' to their evidence list, atomic write, receipt. This is repo-local state, not CRM — no approval flag needed, but it runs only on an explicit proposal file.

EXTEND scripts/funnel_controller.py (surgical; keep all existing tests green):
4. PAST-GUEST ROUTING (owner rule from today: a published guest must never get a guest-funnel nudge): people whose ledger stage is published (or whose roster stage_hubspot maps at-or-after published) are excluded from nudge_due and new_outreach; when such a person has a fresh inbound touch, emit kind 'referral_followup' instead {reason: 'past guest <name> wrote in — route to referral lane, never guest nudging'}, prioritized with hold_expired items. Accept an optional --roster <path> input for the stage_hubspot lookup (absent roster = ledger stages only, behavior otherwise unchanged).

TESTS: tests/test_hubspot_stage_sync.py at least 9 tests: crm_stale proposal built with evidence refs; ledger_behind goes to backfill never crm_corrections; stalled/declined always needs_human; apply refuses without approval flags (exit 3); apply refuses an already-approved proposal; apply patches via fixture api-cmd and verifies re-fetch (one success, one verify-mismatch marked failed and nonzero exit); ledger-backfill updates stage + evidence and is idempotent; key never appears in any written artifact (scan outputs for the fixture key string). tests/test_funnel_controller.py: at least 3 NEW tests: published person with inbound becomes referral_followup not nudge_due; published person excluded from new_outreach targeting; roster stage_hubspot published excludes even when ledger lags.
